Anya: Quick RFC follow-up: proposal for a lightweight 'hydration-lane' adapter for safetensors. Loader exposes lanes (hot, warm, cold) and returns short-lived lease tokens. Runtime pins lease for request lifetime to avoid KV-cache mismatch.

Ravi: How minimal should the loader surface be? Sketch: Acquire(layerId, lane, deadlineMs) -> (leaseId, readyBool) and Stream(layerId) -> async stream. Lease IDs must be opaque so we can change internals later.

Lena: Concern: what happens if a layer is demoted mid-request? Lease TTL + pinning solves that. Leases should be valid for request duration + 200ms. Also add a migration CAS semantic when swapping tokens.

Anya: For tiny layers we should inline them. Default inline cutoff 128KB. Acquire returns ready=true and a lease that is essentially a pointer into in-memory buffer.

Ravi: Telemetry: acquire_latency_ms{lane}, inline_count, streamed_bytes_by_lane, fallback_count. infra-bot please create INF ticket.

infra-bot: Created INF-2048 "hydration-lanes-metrics" and assigned to eng-ml.

Lena: Compatibility: provide an adapter shim mapping Acquire->legacy Fetch. If legacy backend returns a blob, shim should materialize a lease id like "legacy:<sha>" and mark ready based on size. That keeps rollout incremental.

Anya: Failure modes: if Stream errors mid-read, runtime should attempt fast in-memory fallback for remainder, then fail. Add backoff to avoid retry storms.

Ravi: Start with lane HINTS only; runtime may ignore when under pressure. Keep three lanes to start.

Lena: Placement hint in lease metadata would help colocating hot shards. Add a placement_hint string in the lease payload.

Anya: I'll draft a brief addendum with API, lease TTL, inline cutoff, shim pseudo-code, and telemetry list. Sync Monday 9:30am. Any objections?

Ravi: No objections.

Lena: LGTM.
